name: gang-anime-studio
description: GANG ANIME STUDIO — estudio de producción de anime 2D (monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,studio "npm run dev -w @gas/server" "npm run dev -w @gas/studio"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @gas/server
scripts.e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
